## get-service-account

Kind: Read.

Use `list-service-account-policies` with the service account ID to see attached
policies.

| Flag                   | Type     | Required |
| ---------------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--service-account-id` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode iam get-service-account --service-account-id <service-account-id> --query ServiceAccount
```

## get-user

Kind: Read.

`User.MFA` exposes nullable `Email` and `GoogleAuthenticator` factor states.
Contact and enrolment details are withheld.

Use `list-user-policies` and `list-user-groups` with the user ID to see attached
policies and memberships.

| Flag        | Type     | Required |
| ----------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--user-id` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode iam get-user --user-id <user-id> --query User
```

## list-users

Kind: Read.

Returns one zero-based page. The default size is 10000. Unknown page metadata is
null.

`--name` filters by a case-insensitive substring, as observed on the accounts
API.

Use `list-user-policies` and `list-user-groups` with the user ID to see attached
policies and memberships.

| Flag     | Type     | Required |
| -------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--page` | `int`    |          |
| `--size` | `int`    |          |
| `--name` | `string` |          |

```sh
greennode iam list-users
```
